gap.title: A step toward: 4-cycle-free bipartite incidence: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for it can be replaced by a two-level one (point ORs, line ORs, their ANDs, ORs) no larger (step 2 of 2)
gap.statement: ∀ (x1 x2 : ℕ) (x3 : Finset (Fin x1 × Fin x2)) (x4 : Fin x1 × Fin x2) (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x4 ∈ x3 → (fun (x7 : Finset (Fin x1 × Fin x2)) (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (x1 + x2) x8 ∧ ∀ (x9 : Fin (x1 + x2) → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (x1 + x2) x8 x9 = Decidable.decide (∃ (x10 : Fin x1) (x11 : Fin x2), (x10, x11) ∈ x7 ∧ x9 (Fin.castAdd x2 x10) = Bool.true ∧ x9 (Fin.natAdd x1 x11) = Bool.true)) x3 x5 → ∃ (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x8.size < x5.size ∧ (fun (x9 : Finset (Fin x1 × Fin x2)) (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (x1 + x2) x10 ∧ ∀ (x11 : Fin (x1 + x2) → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (x1 + x2) x10 x11 = Decidable.decide (∃ (x12 : Fin x1) (x13 : Fin x2), (x12, x13) ∈ x9 ∧ x11 (Fin.castAdd x2 x12) = Bool.true ∧ x11 (Fin.natAdd x1 x13) = Bool.true)) (x3.erase x4) x8
